alt: Real ChatGPT /spacedrepetition execution: fast prompt entry, sending, accelerated generation and normal-speed widget use.
caption: New temporary chat → PDF → shortcut → generation → extended widget use
prompt: /spacedrepetition Using only the attached chapter, create an interactive three-card spaced-review widget on training versus inference. Include reveal, review marking and progress. Answer in English.
setupPrompt: Use the attached chapter as the only source for the next activity. Please wait for my next request.

phases.name: upload
phases.caption: Open a new temporary chat and upload the chapter PDF.

phases.name: setup-generation
phases.caption: ChatGPT reads the uploaded chapter · accelerated.

phases.name: typing
phases.caption: Write the shortcut request as the second message.

phases.name: send
phases.caption: Send the shortcut as the second message.

phases.name: widget
phases.caption: Inspect the generated widget before using its controls.

phases.name: usage
phases.caption: Use the widget at normal speed.

actions.label: Recall the parameter-change distinction, then reveal the first answer.
Rate the first distinction as Good and inspect the review counter.
Reveal the second explanation after recalling it independently.
Rate this concept as Hard to distinguish it from remembered material.
Reveal the context answer and compare it with the definition of training.
Rate the third concept Again to keep it in the difficult set.
Inspect the summary: one Again, one Hard, and one Good card.
Start another review round without sending a new message.
Reveal the first concept again in the new round.
Re-rate the concept as Good after successful recall.
Use Previous to revisit the earlier card.

deliveryNormalization.method: Aspect-preserving Lanczos downsample from 1664x1040 to 1440x900. H.264 CRF14; original 60 fps cadence and duration preserved. Native media retained in the ignored pre-pull review archive.
